translation_notes: prefixes: GEO->geo, DCTERMS->dcterms, OWL->owl, PROV->prov, RDF->rdf (RDF.type is written as the 'a' shorthand, so rdf: ends up unused, matching the unused RDF import already in original.py), RDFS->rdfs, SDO->sdo, XSD->xsd. DCTERMS/OWL/PROV/SDO are imported but unused in this region in original.py too (they serve other functions in the source file); kept for import-surface parity.

Context shim sawgraph_shim.py restores initial_kg/build_aq_iris/build_aqsys_iris -- defined earlier in the SAME source file (lines 243-275), outside the extracted region -- copied verbatim, plus a _PREFIX dict and a find_s2_intersects_poly stub standing in for the project's namespaces.py (outside this repo, reached via sys.path.insert against a sibling checkout). Also added `import logging`, missing in the original extraction (logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) has no binding otherwise). Identical for both representations.

Five Literal(x, datatype=...) sites, all on COMPUTED values -- this region is the stratum's density case (55 rdf_ops): (1) Literal(aqid, XSD.string) and Literal(row.aqtype, XSD.string), aqid/row.aqtype already str -> quoted typed-literal "{aqid}"^^xsd:string (safe: no rdflib lexical normalisation for xsd:string); (2) Literal(f'A {row.aqtype} aquifer in Illinois', XSD.string), an f-string with real interpolation, str -> same quoted form "A {row.aqtype} aquifer in Illinois"^^xsd:string; (3) Literal('CM' + str(row.saw_id).zfill(...), XSD.string), str -> "CM{str(row.saw_id).zfill(max_id_length)}"^^xsd:string; (4) Literal(row.geometry, datatype=GEO.wktLiteral) (twice) -- row.geometry is a shapely geometry OBJECT, not a string, so the quoted str-interpolation form is NOT safe by the trap-1 argument; used the bare coercion form {row.geometry}^^geo:wktLiteral instead, which goes through the same value->lexical conversion rdflib's Literal(value, datatype=dt) constructor uses (INSTRUCTIONS.md Sec. 2 bis).

Literal('A system of aquifers in Illinois', datatype=XSD.string) and Literal(f'Illinois aquifer systems consist of ... 50ft ...', datatype=XSD.string) (the second is an f-string with NO {} placeholders, i.e. a constant despite the f-prefix) are both constant values -> plain Turtle typed literals "..."^^xsd:string, per the stratum's rule (constant value -> "..."^^xsd:... directly, no interpolation).

EXCLUDED, not because of the translation: both original.py and translated.ldpy fail identically at `import geopandas`, not installed in the study venv, and the region additionally reads four real .shp files not present in this corpus checkout. Faking geopandas.read_file with synthetic in-memory geometries was considered and rejected: it would mean inventing domain data (shapefile attribute rows, WKT geometries) disconnected from the real dataset, which is business-logic invention, not binding restoration -- the same call made for the Display-Lab region in this batch. Transpilation was still verified independently (python -c transpile+compile succeeds; see driver.py's docstring) and rdfeval check's FAIL is the expected, documented ModuleNotFoundError on both sides.
